traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ οἴκου Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: Et ambulávit in viis domus Achab :
traditions.KJV: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab ,

27.english_reference: and did evil in the sight of the LORD , as [ did ] the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַשׂ הָ רַ֛ע בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ בֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιον Κυρίου καθὼς ὁ οἶκος Ἀχαάβ .
traditions.VUL: et fecit quod malum est coram Dómino , sicut domus Achab :
traditions.KJV: and did evil in the sight of the LORD , as [ did ] the house of Ahab :

27.english_reference: for he [ was ] the son in law of the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י חֲתַ֥ן בֵּית אַחְאָ֖ב הֽוּא
traditions.VUL: gener enim domus Achab fuit .
traditions.KJV: for he [ was ] the son in law of the house of Ahab .

28.english_reference: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֗ב לַ מִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם חֲזָהאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם בְּ רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετὰ Ἰωρὰμ υἱοῦ Ἀχαὰβ εἰς πόλεμον μετὰ Ἁζαὴλ βασιλέως ἀλλοφύλων ἐν Ῥεμμὼθ Γαλαάδ ,
traditions.VUL: Abiit quoque cum Ioram fílio Achab ad prœliándum contra Házael regem Sýriæ in Ramoth Gálaad ,
traditions.KJV: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּ֥וּ אֲרַמִּ֖ים אֶת יוֹרָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξαν οἱ Σύροι τὸν Ἰωράμ .
traditions.VUL: et vulneravérunt Syri Ioram .
traditions.KJV: and the Syrians wounded Joram .

29.english_reference: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשָׁב֩ יוֹרָ֨ם הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ הִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְ יִזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן הַ מַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֻּ֤ הוּ אֲרַמִּים֙ בָּֽ רָמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰωρὰμ τοῦ ἰατρευθῆναι ἐν Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ τῶν πληγῶν ὧν ἐπάταξαν αὐτὸν ἐν Ῥεμμὼθ
traditions.VUL: Qui revérsus est ut curarétur in Iézrahel , quia vulneráverant eum Syri in Ramoth
traditions.KJV: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah ,

29.english_reference: when he fought against Hazael king of Syria

traditions.WLC: בְּ הִלָּ֣חֲמ֔ וֹ אֶת חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ πολεμεῖν αὐτὸν μετὰ Ἁζαὴλ βασιλέως Συρίας ·
traditions.VUL: prœliántem contra Házael regem Sýriæ .
traditions.KJV: when he fought against Hazael king of Syria .

29.english_reference: And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִ רְא֞וֹת אֶת יוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֛ב בְּ יִזְרְעֶ֖אל
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ὀχοζεὶ υἱὸς Ἰωρὰμ κατέβη τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὸν Ἰωρὰμ υἱὸν Ἀχαὰβ ἐν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Porro Ochozías fílius Ioram rex Iuda descéndit invísere Ioram fílium Achab in Iézrahel ,
traditions.KJV: And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἠρρώστει αὐτός .
traditions.VUL: quia ægrotábat ibi .
traditions.KJV: because he was sick .
